chunks: Alas the woe that day for those who deny!

key_terms.لِلْمُکَذِّبِينَ: For the deniers, those who rejected the truth
key_terms.وَيْلٌ: Woe or calamity, a specific type of punishment in Hell
key_terms.يَوْمَئِذٍ: That day, referring to the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Wail' for the deniers in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Wail' is understood not merely as a cry of regret but as a specific, intense punishment reserved for the disbelievers who actively rejected the Prophet's message. This verse underscores the finality of divine judgment, linking the historical denial of the Messengers to the eternal consequences faced by their followers on the Day of Resurrection.
